implementation: Flutter voice-dock buttons now expose a single semantic button with enabled/tap state. Microphone and deafen labels and toggled state, and the stream-alert action label versus current setting state, match VoiceDock.vue aria-label/aria-pressed behavior.

checks.name: Web reference comparison
checks.observation: frontend/src/voice/VoiceDock.vue uses aria-label for each control action and aria-pressed for microphone, deafen and stream-alert state. Flutter now exposes matching labels and toggle state without duplicating the visual tooltip in the semantics tree.

checks.name: Voice dock accessibility widget coverage
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states"
checks.observation: Checks microphone and deafen labels/state, stream-alert action label/current state/tap action and state changes, and deafen becoming toggled after the transition.

remaining: Verify spoken names, pressed-state announcements, keyboard/switch access and focus behavior with VoiceOver on macOS, NVDA on Windows, and TalkBack on Android.
